name: Text Extraction Software Benchmark (synthesized dataset)
description: A synthesized dataset and evaluation suite for measuring the accuracy and robustness of text extraction/software OCR systems.
reputation: A specialized synthetic OCR evaluation suite with moderate use in OCR and document analysis research, but not a ubiquitous community standard.
notes: Synthetic data may not reflect real-world document variability; susceptible to overfitting and saturation by dedicated OCR systems; primarily a non-LLM benchmark; evaluated using character/word error rates.
